vb_textbox.text: Stick to one charatcher if the mushrooms collected are higher than four. Usually the red and violet ones gave more mushrooms but this wasn't always the case. If you notice that the red and violet gnomes give you less than four mushrooms, change gnomes and you will be rewarded. If the other gnomes (brown and green) give you more than four mushrooms, stick with them until the number of mushrooms decreses.
